A four-panel illustration showing the Parable of the Sower. Panel 1: A seed on a hard dirt path being eaten by a crow. Panel 2: A small green shoot withering under a blazing yellow sun on stony ground. Panel 3: A green plant being strangled by thorny vines. Panel 4: A tall, healthy stalk of wheat full of grain in rich brown soil.

A scene of the Prodigal Son's return. An older, bearded man (the father) is running down a dirt road with his arms outstretched. Meeting him is a young man on his knees, dressed in torn, dirty rags, looking up with a sorrowful expression. In the background, a large house and servants bringing a fine robe and a ring.
